notes: v23 enemy (Hollow region): the Giant, boss (Hex7, ~2.5 hexes wide), personality cross, sleepy-grumpy. A huge mossy-fur mound sitting on its haunches with a small grumpy cat face high on the front (violet eyes, a painted cross frown -- no modelled mouth, so no jaw bone), two short clawed front paws under the fur bib (x -0.19 and +0.06; the head sits left of centre at x ~-0.17), one hind foot showing at the right side (stays on the body), violet cape flaps at the base (body). Its back was a smooth blob (Meshy only saw the front): meshfix/giant_fur.py gave it the front coat's fur (relief + painted locks). Blob rig: the ball squashes, the face rides on it as a rigid follower, each front paw is a modelled furry arm (round 2) rigid to its own leg-pair bone, pivoting at a shoulder inside the body for the stomp-shuffle, the paw swipe and the slam. Big and slow.
